verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents a first-party Teams developer platform: a quickstart for building an agent, a guide to porting Slack Bolt apps, and the Agents Toolkit CLI and IDE extensions, which scaffold apps from templates and samples, provision, deploy, and publish. The Graph Teams API is documented for programmatic automation. However, none of the evidence names actual official SDK packages, supported languages, or SDK reference docs, so SDK support is only implied by this tooling. One community comment says integration requires the full Azure/Graph stack, which signals complexity rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: explicit naming of official SDK libraries and languages, SDK reference documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
